texts.facts: Petitioner admittedly had supplied certain products to the 1st respondent corporation on the basis of a tender awarded to the petitioner. However, Ext.P17 show cause notice was issued to the petitioner pointing out certain discrepancies in the earlier supply made by the petitioner. Thereupon, petitioner has submitted Ext.P18 reply. It is also pointed out by the petitioner that in Ext.P17 the details are not furnished to the petitioner which disables the petitioner from giving a proper reply to the show cause notice. However, the subject matter is pending before the authority, but the respondents are reluctant to release the amounts due to the petitioner on the basis of supply made by the petitioner, on the alleged reason that on securing a report from the analytical lab it was found that the products supplied by the petitioner were of inferior quality. It is in this background petitioner seeks appropriate direction from this Court for the payment against the supply made by the petitioner.
texts.arguments: 2. Respondents have filed a detailed counter affidavit refuting the claims and demands made by the petitioner and also contenting that since, there is a report drawn by the respondent from the Regional Analytical Laboratory as per the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, damages is to be quantified by the 1st respondent against the petitioner and the subject matter is pending consideration before the Managing Director of the Corporation.
